deploy-bot: Build started for image ghcr.io/redwood/inference/runtime:2026-03-20-abc123 (commit abc123def) -> pushing to ghcr prod-registry. Env=prod-canary. Notifying push start.

deploy-bot: [progress] manifest uploaded, starting blob upload (layer 3/7). Estimated remaining ~120s.

elaine: saw a spike in blob upload latency for layer 3 in us-west-2 mirror, is this normal?

deploy-bot: blob upload stalled >90s for chunk streaming, retrying chunk upload (retry 1/3). HTTP 502 from mirror-edge-2.

marco: pinging registry infra, adding alternate route. @sre-oncall can you confirm whether to abort if retry fails?

sre-oncall: checking mirror logs — multiple transient 502s but not an auth failure. my call: allow retries, but set a soft cutoff +5m. if still stuck, abort and pin to last-known-good.

anya: canary traffic low, we can afford to hold. if aborting, we'll need to update the rollout notes and re-trigger canary. recommend waiting 3m first.

deploy-bot: retry succeeded. blob upload resumed, finishing layer 3. Progress: 5/7 layers uploaded.

elaine: great — before we continue, please snapshot the image for fast rollback if needed. tag: snapshot/1961122334-abc123

deploy-bot: tagging image ghcr.io/redwood/inference/runtime:snapshot-1961122334-abc123

elaine: also verify digest after push:
```
# verify
skopeo inspect docker://ghcr.io/redwood/inference/runtime:snapshot-1961122334-abc123 | jq .Digest
```

deploy-bot: push complete. image digest: sha256:0f1e2d3c4b5a6c7d8e9f0a1b2c3d4e5f6a7b8c9d0e1f2a3b4c5d6e7f8a9b0c1 (truncated). Canary deploy started (route=prod-canary). Monitor latency and error budget.

elaine: noted. I updated the release-window doc with the snapshot tag and rollback steps. :white_check_mark:

sre-oncall: will watch for 10m. escalate if error rate >1% or latency >200ms p95.

deploy-bot: Deploy finished for prod-canary. rollout_status=healthy. Finished at 1961122860.
